selector_result.evaluation_process: Q1 fills in device-specific eligibility restrictions, minimum production quantities, or forbidden combinations (G003), which directly affects the feasible decision set and could silently exclude or include devices. Q2 fills in whether maximum processing capacity is a hard or soft limit (G004), a hard-versus-soft policy that changes the constraint structure and feasibility. Q3 fills in whether production quantities must be integer or may be fractional (G007), which is largely a mathematical modeling detail and less likely to change the core business structure. Given the confirmed context that exactly one device must produce all 2000 units and each device's capacity is below 2000, the most critical unresolved business rule is whether any device is ineligible or has minimum production requirements, because that determines which devices are even candidates and prevents the Agent from silently assuming all four devices are usable. Q1 is therefore the best next question.
